# DELETE /api/v1/orgs/{org}/members/{username}

Remove a member from an organization. Removes from all teams, deletes repo access, unwatches repos.

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-076`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| username | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Organization or user not found
- **500** — User is last org owner (ErrLastOrgOwner)

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | orgAssignment | middleware | Resolve org by name |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | reqOrgOwnership | middleware | Check if doer is site admin or org owner |
| 3 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.GetContextUserByPathParam | utility | Resolve target user by name |
| 4 | [services](../modules/services.md) | org_service.RemoveOrgUser | service | Check if user is org member; Check if user is last owner (prevent removal); Within transaction: delete OrgUser, decrement num_members; Get accessible repos, unwatch them, delete access records; Remove from all teams via removeTeamMember per team |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| RemoveOrgUser prevents removal of last org owner | business_logic | User is owner AND owner team has only 1 member AND that member is the user |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| User is last owner of org | 500 | internal error | False |
| User not in org_user | 204 | silent success (no-op) | False |

### Error Paths

- **Org not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **Doer not org owner** → reqOrgOwnership → 403
- **User not found** → GetContextUserByPathParam → 404
- **User not a member** → RemoveOrgUser → 204
- **User is last owner** → RemoveOrgUser → 500

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| high | n_plus_1_queries | RemoveOrgUser iterates over all user's repos calling WatchRepo per repo, then iterates over all teams calling removeTeamMember per team. Each removeTeamMember itself iterates over team repos calling RecalculateUserAccess per repo. | Batch repo loading and batch access recalculation instead of per-repo loops |
| medium | synchronous_blocking | The entire member removal (including all team removals and access recalculations) runs in a single long-running database transaction | Consider breaking into smaller transactions or using async processing for access cleanup |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P1] query_optimization**: Batch load repos instead of per-ID GetRepositoryByID calls in the unwatch loop — *Impact: Reduce N repo queries to 1 batch query*
- **[P2] query_optimization**: Batch delete access records and unwatch in single queries instead of per-repo operations — *Impact: Reduce 2N queries to 2 queries for repos*
